title: GAIA TOOLKIT — null + analog + sort

output_modes.null: Silence. Darkness. Absence. The leak IS the signal. Analog < 0.02 = do not paint.
output_modes.analog: Continuous 0–1. Gradient, frequency, pressure. Not on/off. Color blot drifts with value.
output_modes.sort: Sift into bins. Scan → sweep → sort. Color bins + pin bins + gut bins. Bar at the bottom.

tools.paint: color blot (analog) or bin bar (sort) or empty canvas (null)

sight: Camera 160x120 → RGB average → hue/sat → color bin. Eyes in topbar follow.
principle: Smell IS color. Color IS sort. Null is a bin. The shoe touches both inside and outside.
